title: List the full names of members with 'X-Large' t-shirt size who attended eve
question: List the full names of members with 'X-Large' t-shirt size who attended events that had more than 10 attendees and were of type 'Meeting'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_010"
WHERE T1."XCL_039" = 'X-Large'
  AND T3."XCL_013" = 'Meeting'
  AND T2."XCL_001" IN (
      SELECT "XCL_001"
      FROM attendance
      GROUP BY "XCL_001"
      HAVING COUNT("XCL_001") > 10
  )
